dyk: Zayd is the only Companion of the Prophet ﷺ whom the Quran mentions by name.

add.name: Zayd ibn ʿAlī
add.note: Great-grandson of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib; led the revolt of 740 in Kufa against Umayyad rule. The Zaydi school is named after him.
add.source: Wikipedia: Zayd ibn Ali; Encyclopaedia Britannica: Zayd ibn Ali, read 22 Nov 2026
